Correction: the closing note on this bead (op 20261025T002809.038117Z-p86607-c0001-r2c35-h031cbf) was posted empty by a shell error ($(cat) read no input). Its intended text:
Frozen labels (ADR 0027 section 7), local only under data/source-identity/part-b/s3c3 (rule 14d), files made read-only.
- labels.json sha256 8584a090aec503a0bc1b4b09fef969addd3d68358824233e6352aba91f9dc165; schema source-identity-labels/v1; 43 pairs equal to universe.json (sha256 30ef90bea461f186a5ff61d6684c239ea22839f132e66f2f423a04934731fe55) exactly, sorted, no duplicates.
- packet.json built by build_packet.py from run-1 inputs, transcript and media: decoder-segment context +-2, row lists, one frame at each mention and one per candidate row (32 frames). No proposals, graph or scene descriptions.
- Labeller: one fresh-context agent confined to the packet directory, no web. Counts: same 3 (d-w106/v-r503-jennifer-wilson, d-w198/v-r557-john, d-w198/v-r558-john), different 40, no pair labelled can't tell; it reported 0 pairs decided by plot memory.
- Labeller run metadata, from the agent harness's completion record: 6 tool uses, 27014 ms. With 32 frames, it cannot have viewed every frame.
- Disclosed limits: agent judgments, not human labels; the model has prior knowledge of the episode. The owner may substitute human labels.
